Reservation terms

iNotes

• The above prices are in euros per room/per night with buffet breakfast.
• Half board - 16 EUR per day per adult, 15EUR per day per child (2-9.99 years old)
• Baby cot (0-1,99 y.o.) is free of charge. Normal bed for child 0-1.99 - extra charge 10€ per day.
• From 01/06 until 30/08 minimum stay is 3 nights.
• Note: Tourist tax (5€ per day/room) is not included in regular prices.
• A deposit of 30% of the total price of the reservation is required to confirm a booking. The remaining balance will be paid 48 hours before the arrival day.

Cancelation policy
• If a reservation is canceled up to 7 days before the date of arrival, the deposit will be 100% refunded, minus the administrative fee which in most cases is 30€ but it could be more.
• If a reservation is canceled 6-2 days before the arrival date, one night's stay will be charged.
• If the accommodation unit is canceled later or in case of a no-show, the owner of the facility has the right to keep the entire fee for the deposit and it will not be returned to the guest.
• In case of an early departure, 100% of the remaining days will be charged.

Accommodation description

Hotel Mallas is situated in a privileged place in the centre of Nea Kallikratia, just 100 meters from the beach, 35km from Thessaloniki and 25km from the international airport “MAKEDONIA”.

Accommodation

The hotel has 35 comfortable rooms, all equipped with a/c, telephone, refrigerator, central heating, bathroom and large balconies.

The hospitality of the personnel and the services provided, such as: rich breakfast, lunch in buffet, 24 hours room-service, car rental and internet provider will make your hospitality unforgettable.

Show full description Hide the rest

You can also enjoy your drink to the lounge, or in the garden next to the pool.  

The friendly atmosphere, the exceptional service and the comforts provided, guarantee a warm and unforgettable staying.

Close to the hotel, you will also find a laundry, a hair-dresser and a playground for your children that make your stay even more wonderful.

Guest reviews

Our guests share their experiences and impressions of their stay.

Vladan Marinkovic

28.06.2018
Hotel Malas je porodicni hotel u kome nema primedbi na higijenu i hranu, ali bezbednost u hotelu je na nultom nivou s obzirom da sam pokraden u sobi 229... nestao je sav novac dok smo bili na plazi. Cudno ali istinito u hotelu koji ima recepciju, ne bi trebalo da ima lopova! Jos dve porodice su ostale bez para na isti nacin! Vlasnik hotela osim sto je izjavio da mu je zao, nista ali bas nista nije preduzeo da nam se nadje od pomoci ili ponudi bilo kakvo resenje za kradju novca iz hotela. S obzirom da sam morao dati izjavu policiji i da je to duze trajalo, ostao sam bez vecere koju sam imao uplacenu u hotelu. Po povratku iz policije nisu me ni ponudili vecerom. Razmislite da li da boravite u ovakvom hotelu. Sve sto sam naveo dogodilo se 22.6.2018

Location and nearby beaches

Nea Kallikrateia, Halkidiki

Nea Kallikrateia is a coastal town near Thessaloniki, making it a convenient choice for travelers looking for an easy and quick seaside getaway. The town has a long sandy beach with shallow, calm water suitable for families with children. Accommodation includes family-run apartments, small hotels, and rooms close to the sea and the main promenade. The center of Nea Kallikrateia has many cafés, bakeries, shops, and taverns, creating a lively but relaxed summer atmosphere. Because of its location, the town is also a good base for day trips to Thessaloniki or the rest of Halkidiki. The beach is easily accessible and well-maintained, making everyday swimming simple and pleasant. Nea Kallikrateia is ideal for travelers who want comfort, good infrastructure, and a peaceful coastal environment.
